podcast_name: Pet Boarding and Daycare Podcast with Dominic Hodgson
episode_title: Ep. 141 – Stop Hiring Like It’s 2016: How to Recruit & Retain Great Gen Z Pet Care Staff
question: How should pet care businesses replace traditional job posts to attract Gen Z candidates?
transcript_excerpt: Rich Schlatter recommends treating hiring like marketing and moving away from static black-and-white text job descriptions on platforms like Indeed. Instead, use eye-popping video ads with the right words, pictures, and audio that speak directly to dog-obsessed candidates. He provides 30-second video snippets showing daycare areas, front desk, and facility tours. He also emphasizes using text and email as first contact methods rather than forcing face-to-face interviews, then conducting brief 10-minute video calls to showcase management style and benefits before in-person tours.

question: What is the cost of hiring and training a new pet care staff member?
transcript_excerpt: In New Jersey, the cost of hiring and training one new staff member for one week, including administrative costs, uniforms, and pre-training, is in excess of $5,000. This figure includes interviewer time, trainer time, staff member orientation, and all associated overhead expenses.
